cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm writing to apply for the UX Conversational Designer position. My background sits at the intersection of digital marketing, SEO, and AI, with a technical foundation that lets me translate complex logic into simple, intuitive experiences.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I handle on-page SEO, keyword research, and SEO content for client websites, tracking results with Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Search Console. I also build and maintain a pharmacists' association site in WordPress/Elementor, including a consistent layout for around 600 member profile pages. Previously, at Knowledge Experts (KXP), I supported the team in building SharePoint-based digital workplace sites for large enterprises like ŞOK Market and Aras Kargo, designed and built client websites in WordPress, and ran SEO analyses and performance reports. I also built and optimized mirook.com, implementing JSON-LD schema, knowledge-graph markup, and an llms.txt file, and ran iterative technical SEO/GEO audits that measurably raised the site's search-health score.

I use LLMs daily for research, content, and audits, and I've built AI agents and MCP integrations that work directly with WordPress, analytics, and SEO tools. This hands-on experience with AI-powered products and prompt engineering gives me a strong understanding of both the possibilities and limitations of conversational interfaces. I'm fluent in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 writing level, and I enjoy collaborating with cross-functional teams.

I'm passionate about language, technology, and AI, and I'm eager to learn and take initiative. I'd welcome the chance to bring my mix of marketing, technical, and AI skills to your conversational design team.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

baverok@gmail.com
